name: Isshobin Wine (1.8L Bottle)
description: Served from a traditional 1.8L Japanese sake bottle (isshobin), this wine represents the fusion of Japanese sake culture with winemaking. An approachable, conversation-starting way to enjoy wine at the table. Available in red or white.

name: Kamoshi Koshu (Bottled Wine)
description: A premium Koshu white wine with bright acidity and delicate stone fruit notes. Koshu is a uniquely Japanese grape variety with over a thousand years of history — this bottling expresses its elegance with a clean, lingering finish.

name: Wakao Orchard Wine (Bottled)
description: An artisanal wine from Wakao Orchard — a family-run estate known for its meticulous cultivation and natural winemaking approach. Each vintage reflects the orchard's dedication to quality and seasonal expression.

name: Koshu Hyaku (Bottled Wine)
description: An expressive Koshu varietal wine, available in both red and white. Hyaku means 'one hundred' — a nod to the commitment to perfection in every bottle. Rich in fruit character with a refined, balanced finish.
